text: The mirror gives way to a narrow coatroom inside the Brugh. A half-open service panel admits a small attendant who waits for your first decision.

views.text: The mirror gives way to a cramped, dim coatroom. A shabby goat-faced attendant peers through the service panel, wary but not violent.
The mirror gives way to a polished palace coatroom. A composed attendant in a dark coat welcomes you beneath warm brass lamps.
